text:
jules: Dropping a quick design review for the new 'first-run spotlight' — small persistent card pinned under header with checklist progress + a single prominent CTA and a slim sample projects rail. Mock: https://img.redwood.in/spotlight-card-v1.png rani: Nice. One thing: microcopy feels generic. "Get started" -> can we test more specific CTAs? e.g., 'Connect API key' vs 'Walk the tour'. Also worried about visual competition with top nav items. otto: Agree on copy. Also contrast on the sample link is pretty low in the mock (2.9:1). Needs to hit 4.5:1 or be bolded. clare: Accessibility check: should the spotlight be reachable via keyboard without stealing focus on page load. Recommend not auto-focusing but include a skip link and an aria-live region for progress updates. For screen readers: announce "Spotlight: 2 steps left" when it appears. rachel: Telemetry plan: events `spotlight_impression`, `spotlight_cta_click` {cta: connect|tour|sample}, `spotlight_dismiss`. Add `variant: card|rail` for the experiment. We'll want to see `time_to_cta` too. jules: Good calls. Proposed decisions: anchored card (not overlay), primary CTA copy = "Connect your first API key (~2m)", secondary = "Try a sample project", show "Don't show again" checkbox, dismiss icon with aria-label. We'll also run an A/B with a minimal rail variant (card vs rail). otto: Copy tweak for the CTA: long text in button might wrap on small screens. Suggest short label + meta text underneath in smaller font: primary action = "Connect API key" and a separate inline meta "(~2 min)". Also ensure button has min-height 40px for touch targets. clare: ARIA snippet suggestion for devs: `
\n

Spotlight: 2 steps left

\n \n Try a sample project\n \n \n
` rachel: We'll log `spotlight_variant` and add `cta_meta_shown:true|false`. For experiments, set feature flag `spotlight_first_run_v1`. jules: Design nit from research: users responded better when the card showed '1 of 3 complete' instead of '2 steps left'. Can we A/B that phrasing? otto: Yes A/B: A) steps left B) progress fraction. Also small accessibility nit: progress text should be in text, not just an icon so screen readers read it. clare: Keyboard flow: Tab order should be title -> primary CTA -> sample link -> don't show checkbox -> dismiss. ESC should close and emit `spotlight_dismiss`. Dismiss should return focus to the global header item that triggered the spotlight (if any). rachel: Also track `dismiss_reason` (user|esc|dont_show). We'll want to capture `screen_width` to correlate wrap issues. jules: Implementation asks: 1) ensure contrast 4.5:1 on link and button text, 2) CTA short label + meta line, 3) aria-live polite status, 4) dismiss and don't-show options, 5) telemetry events per Rachel, 6) feature flag for experiment. Otto/Clare can you add dev-acceptance items to the PR? otto: I'll add keyboard/focus tests and CSS tokens for min-height and focus ring. clare: I'll add ARIA snippets and add an assertion that the status is announced on reveal. Also add guidance to avoid trapping focus. design-bot: Feature flag `spotlight_first_run_v1` created. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/spotlight-first-run. jules: Final decision for MVP: anchored spotlight card under header, primary CTA = 'Connect API key' + meta (~2 min) on a separate inline span, secondary link 'Try a sample project', include 'Don't show again' checkbox, dismiss button (aria-label set), aria-live politesse for progress, telemetry events as specified, run A/B phrase experiment steps-left vs fraction for 10 days. Priors: Otto and Clare to post PR-ready snippets by EOD tomorrow. Thanks :sparkles:
